newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh steps up dengue fever precautions.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh steps up dengue fever precautions.

text.p: Bangladesh, alarmed by the outbreak of dengue fever in neighbouring India, has tightened health checks on travellers entering the country.
"We are taking precautions. It's not wise to sit idle when lots of people are travelling to and from India every day," Monindra Chowdhury, director of the Institute of Epidemiology, said on Monday.
Port officials had been advised of the symptoms of dengue fever and "our doctors are keeping watch at airports", he said.
Health officials said no dengue-positive cases had so far been detected.

Dengue, a mosquito-borne disease also called breakbone fever, has killed at least 260 people in New Delhi since it broke out during monsoon rains in late August. Officials in the Indian capital said last week that the outbreak had peaked and the death rate had declined sharply.
